criterionAnalysis: 2.4.3 Focus Order asks for an order that keeps meaning and operability. Tab walks the whole form (Edit, Currency, Amount, Payer memo, Upload attachment, Methods, the two checkboxes and the Stripe link, Destination account, Back, Create & send) before the preview pane (three payer-page method accordions, then Close), which is the left-to-right reading order of the two columns, and every control stays reachable. 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence is met because the DOM order matches the visual order of the columns. Moving from a left column to a right column is not a backward jump in reading order. No other A or AA criterion governs tab order.
